mentions.name: All About Berlin
mentions.description: A guide website about living in Berlin that the author relies on as his livelihood. AI systems train on its content and divert its audience, and traffic is down 80-85% compared with the same month pre-LLMs. Work in the comment focuses on cutting operating costs to the bare minimum: shutting down one service, replacing a VPS with Cloudflare Workers, trimming SaaS subscriptions, and self-hosting what he can.
mentions.problem: AI systems train on the website's content and use it to deny the author an audience; traffic is down 80-85% from the same month pre-LLMs, making the livelihood-sustaining site's survival doubtful.
mentions.source_excerpt:
AI is still killing the website I live from[0], training its AI on my work and using it to deny me an audience. Traffic is down 80-85% from the same month pre-LLMs.

So I'm cutting operating costs to the bare minimum. Today I shut down one service and replaced a VPS with Cloudflare Workers. I'm also trimming my SaaS subscriptions and self-hosting what I can.
mentions.author: nicbou
